Purrloin

Dark

Unova · Generation 5

Purrloin is a Dark-type Devious Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 0.4 m tall and weighs 10.1 kg. It evolves into Liepard. Its highest base stat is Speed (66), with a base stat total of 281.
